agyos_skill.intent: Use when designing, executing, auditing, or automating a freelancer's outbound client acquisition engine, sales prospecting, cold email/DM outreach campaigns, content marketing, or referral programs.
agyos_skill.instructions: Build a predictable, multi-channel client acquisition engine that generates qualified leads without relying on any single platform or algorithm. To utilize this skill's core methodologies, outreach scripts, or AI prompts, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [02A-PROSPECTING-SYSTEM.md](references/02A-PROSPECTING-SYSTEM.md) | Prospecting System | Outbound list building, Apollo.io search, Hunter.io verification, Sales Navigator semantic filters, Reddit signal monitoring | | [02B-COLD-OUTREACH.md](references/02B-COLD-OUTREACH.md) | Cold Outreach Playbook | DM templates, 5-email follow-up sequence (Day 1→3→7→10→14), copywriting frameworks | | [02C-PLATFORM-STRATEGY.md](references/02C-PLATFORM-STRATEGY.md) | Platform Strategy | Profile optimization for Upwork (JSS hacking) and Contra (commission-free contracts) | | [02D-CONTENT-MARKETING.md](references/02D-CONTENT-MARKETING.md) | Content Marketing Engine | LinkedIn dwell time optimization, viral posting formulas, content repurposing flywheel | | [02E-REFERRAL-ENGINE.md](references/02E-REFERRAL-ENGINE.md) | Referral Engine | Testimonial loops, upsell scripts, affiliate and strategic partner systems | When asked to build lists or identify potential leads: - Reference [02A-PROSPECTING-SYSTEM.md](references/02A-PROSPECTING-SYSTEM.md) to set up filters on Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. - Implement **Signal-Based Prospecting**: focus on target companies that recently raised funding, hired new executives, or published job postings in target technology stacks. - Guide the freelancer to monitor Reddit and communities for direct problem signals. When drafting cold emails, DMs, or follow-up sequences: - Reference [02B-COLD-OUTREACH.md](references/02B-COLD-OUTREACH.md) to apply the **Ultra-Short Value Offer** format (40–60 words, personalized hook, specific outcome proof, low-friction call-to-action). - Structure follow-up campaigns using the 5-email sequence: Day 1 (Value Offer) $\rightarrow$ Day 3 (Case Study snippet) $\rightarrow$ Day 7 (Resource/Quick win) $\rightarrow$ Day 10 (Direct question) $\rightarrow$ Day 14 (Breakup email). When asked to optimize freelancer profiles or proposal strategies on platforms: - Reference [02C-PLATFORM-STRATEGY.md](references/02C-PLATFORM-STRATEGY.md) to structure profiles for SEO and JSS (Job Success Score) maintenance on Upwork. - Compare Upwork's commission model with Contra's flat-fee model ($29/contract) to guide pricing and platform selection. When writing LinkedIn posts or building content plans: - Reference [02D-CONTENT-MARKETING.md](references/02D-CONTENT-MARKETING.md) to write hooks and body copy optimized for **LinkedIn Dwell Time** (dwell time $>$ simple likes). - Leverage the content repurposing flywheel to break down one long-form asset (case study, technical article) into 10 high-impact social posts. When establishing customer retention and referral systems: - Reference [02E-REFERRAL-ENGINE.md](references/02E-REFERRAL-ENGINE.md) to execute the **3-Ask Testimonial Method** (ask at kickoff, ask at delivery, ask 30 days post-delivery). - Establish double-sided referral incentives and strategic agency partnerships.
